title: ChatGPT Voices List (All 9 Voices) & How to Change Voice
description: Compare all 9 ChatGPT Voice Mode voices (Arbor, Breeze, Cove, Ember, Juniper, Maple, Sol, Spruce, Vale)—female, male & UK accents + voice tone rules.
h1: ChatGPT Voice Mode: all 9 voices, female/male/UK options, and tone setup.
dek: Filter Arbor, Breeze, Cove, Ember, Juniper, Maple, Sol, Spruce, and Vale—then copy a spoken-friendly Custom Instructions block so Voice Mode stops reading bullet walls.
lede: ChatGPT’s Voice Mode gives you nine built-in voices spanning female-leaning, male-leaning, US, and British accents. Changing the voice changes how ChatGPT sounds, while adding three short lines to Custom Instructions controls how long it talks and whether it pushes back.
answer: To change ChatGPT's voice on iOS, Android, or desktop, open Settings → Voice (or tap the voice controls inside an active Voice Mode session) and choose from all 9 voices: Juniper, Maple, Sol, and Vale (female-leaning; Vale is British), or Arbor, Breeze, Cove, Ember, and Spruce (male-leaning; Arbor is British). Pair your voice with a 2–4 sentence Custom Instructions rule so spoken answers stay brief.

sections.h2: How to change ChatGPT's voice on iOS, Android, and desktop.
sections.html:
1. Via Settings: Open the ChatGPT app → tap your Profile / Menu → Settings → Voice → preview all nine voices and save.
  2. Mid-conversation: While in Voice Mode, open the voice settings/sliders control (or simply say “Switch your voice to Cove”) to swap voices on the fly.
  3. Fix long spoken monologues: Voice Mode inherits your Settings → Personalization → Custom instructions. Add the concise spoken-cadence block below so ChatGPT stops reading out 90-second bullet lists while you drive or walk.
## Voice & Spoken Cadence Rules - Answer in 2–4 natural spoken sentences first; wait for me to ask before going deeper. - Never read out raw URLs, markdown syntax, or long nested bullet lists aloud. - Give one clear recommendation first instead of an unranked list of five options. - Push back plainly if my premise has a flaw; skip praise and closing offers.

Want to tune ChatGPT’s Base Style presets (Cynic, Robot, Listener, Nerd) alongside Voice Mode? Read our ChatGPT Personality Settings guide.

faq.q: Which ChatGPT voices are female and which are British?
faq.a: Juniper, Maple, Sol, and Vale have female-leaning registers (Vale has a British accent). Arbor, Breeze, Cove, Ember, and Spruce have male-leaning registers (Arbor has a British accent).

faq.q: Why does ChatGPT Voice Mode talk for too long?
faq.a: By default, ChatGPT answers in written-essay structure with bulleted lists and closing offers. Adding a 2–4 sentence spoken-cadence rule in Settings → Personalization → Custom Instructions shortens replies across both voice and text.

faq.q: Do ChatGPT Personality presets (Cynic, Robot, Listener, Nerd) affect Voice Mode?
faq.a: Yes. Your account-wide Base style and tone preset and Custom Instructions apply to new Voice Mode conversations, though you should test changes in a fresh voice chat.

faq.q: Can I change ChatGPT's voice on the web or only on mobile?
faq.a: You can switch voices in Settings → Voice across the ChatGPT iOS, Android, desktop, and supported web clients.
